chapter: Europe and the Black and Blue years
title: Monestier and Tamadjian: touring and studios of Black and Blue
summary: Monestier and his partner Tamadjian promote tours and concerts together. Humes sometimes rode the bus with the musicians. She notes Monestier's pretended lack of understanding and cannot say whether the studio is in Bordeaux or Paris.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan
